'''Robert P. Lipton''' is the Nicholson Professor of Mathematics in the Department of Mathematics at [[Louisiana State University]].<ref>[https://www.math.lsu.edu/people/professors Faculty LSU Math]</ref> He is known for his research on Mathematics of [[Materials science]].

==Academic biography==
Lipton obtained his PhD in Mathematics at [[Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences]] in 1986, as a student of [[Robert V. Kohn]].<ref>[https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=33744 Robert P. Lipton] at the [[Mathematics Genealogy Project]]</ref>  He was a Postdoctoral Associate and Visiting Assistant Professor in the Mathematical Sciences Institute at [[Cornell University]] and a C. B. Morrey Assistant Professor in the Department of Mathematics at [[University of California, Berkeley]]<ref>[https://www.math.lsu.edu/~lipton/CV.html Robert P. Lipton CV]</ref>

== Honors==

He is a fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society |access-date=2022-01-31 |archive-date=2018-08-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180825194636/http://www.ams.org/profession/fellows-list |url-status=dead }}</ref> a fellow of the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]],<ref>[https://www.siam.org/prizes-recognition/fellows-program/all-siam-fellows/class-of-2020 List of Fellows of the Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics, class of 2020]</ref> and a fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]<ref>[https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic List of Fellows of the American Association for the Advancement of Science]</ref>
